2609.01335.title: Bandits in Prod: Hyperparameter Optimization at Inference Time
2609.01335.paper_summary: Many production systems can assess a configuration only by using it on live requests and observing noisy feedback. Modern agentic systems are a prominent example, with inference-time choices such as model selection, retrieval depth, prompting strategy, and decoding temperature, yet often with no representative validation data. We formalize this setting as Online Hyperparameter Optimization (OHPO) and cast it as an infinitely many-armed bandit over mixed and conditional search spaces. We introduce IMABO, a general framework that combines any bandit policy for choosing among already sampled configurations with any oracle for proposing new ones. We instantiate it with IMOSS, a restart-free anytime policy whose active set grows as $t^β$, and prove an expected cumulative quantile-regret bound of $O(p_ρ^{-1/β} + T^{(1+β)/2})$, where $β\in(0,1)$ controls active-set growth and $p_ρ$ lower-bounds the probability that a proposed configuration falls in the top-$ρ$ fraction of the search space. We combine IMOSS with three practical oracles: a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator, an incumbent-mutation oracle driven by a per-coordinate bandit, and a pretrained tabular foundation model, all three improving over the uniform random oracle baseline. IMABO obtains the lowest cumulative regret across diverse OHPO settings, from tuning classical machine-learning models to configuring LLM-based agents.
2609.01335.paper_summary_zh: 許多生產系統只能透過在實際請求上使用配置並觀察嘈雜的反饋來評估配置。現代代理系統是一個顯著的例子，具有推斷時的選擇，例如模型選擇、檢索深度、提示策略和解碼溫度，但通常沒有代表性的驗證數據。我們將這種情況形式化為在線超參數優化（OHPO），並將其視為一個無限多臂賭徒問題，涵蓋混合和條件搜索空間。我們引入了IMABO，這是一個通用框架，將任何用於在已經抽樣的配置中選擇的賭徒策略與任何用於提出新配置的神諭結合起來。我們用IMOSS來具體化它，這是一個無需重啟的隨時政策，其活動集隨著$t^β$增長，並證明了期望累積分位數悔恨界限為$O(p_ρ^{-1/β} + T^{(1+β)/2})$，其中$β\in(0,1)$控制活動集的增長，而$p_ρ$則下界了提議的配置落在搜索空間的前$ρ$部分的概率。我們將IMOSS與三個實用的神諭結合：一個樹狀Parzen估計器、一個由每個坐標賭徒驅動的現任突變神諭，以及一個預訓練的表格基礎模型，這三者都優於均勻隨機神諭基準。IMABO在多樣的OHPO設置中獲得了最低的累積悔恨，從調整傳統機器學習模型到配置基於LLM的代理。
